annotations.title: Trade history (free for own, paid for others)

description: Use this when you want a trader's list of trades, newest first (action, symbol, asset class, quantity, price, time); free for your own trades with auth_token, otherwise $0.01 USDC per 3 trades with x402 on Base (call without payment to see the price). For only the latest trade use trader_last_trade.

auth_token.description: Optional. Your session token from MT_AUTH_TOKEN. If it belongs to twitter_handle, the history is free and no payment is needed.
auth_token.title: Auth Token

limit.description: Number of most recent trades to return, up to 1000. 0 (the default) returns all trades. For someone else's history the price scales with this number.
limit.title: Limit

payment.description: Base64-encoded x402 payment signature. Leave empty on the first call to receive the price and payment requirements, then call again with the signed payment.
payment.title: Payment

twitter_handle.description: X handle of the trader whose trades you want, with or without @.
twitter_handle.title: Twitter Handle

name: trader_get_trade_history
